titulo.estudio: Lire une consigne de santé : Repérer les informations

intro: Understand frequency, duration and precautions in a general health recommendation. Read the French first; open the translation when you want to check your understanding.

texto: Understand frequency, duration and precautions in a general health recommendation. Link the subject with the request and check the dates, conditions and actions the message asks you to carry out.
Point to note: « Depuis », « pendant » and « avant de » place duration and order; do not turn a general recommendation into a diagnosis. In this passage, «notice» means «leaflet».

frases.estudio: La notice indique de prendre un comprimé après le repas, deux fois par jour.
frases.alumno: The leaflet says to take one tablet after the meal, twice a day.

frases.estudio: Le traitement dure cinq jours; il faut lire les précautions avant de commencer.
frases.alumno: The treatment lasts five days; you should read the precautions before starting.
